_comment: A hand-written run config for GLM-5.3-Flash UD-IQ3_XXS (setup.py does not install GLM); docs/GLM.md explains every value.

Replace /path/to/Strata. The values were measured on one RTX 3090 with 94 GiB of RAM: --resident-budget-gib follows setup's rule RAM - 24 - ceil(KV RAM) (67 there), --conversation-cache-mib is 4 GiB because a parked GLM conversation is 152.6 MB of KDA state plus 12,320 B per token.

--glm-pool auto times the CPU pool against staging to the GPU at start; on a 23-core Zen 4 server staging won in real decode (7.05 vs 5.90 tok/s) although auto picked the pool, so measure both (--glm-pool on / off) on a new machine.
serve/models.py's GLM profile adds --eos-ids 154820,154827,154829 and --turn-token 154828 to args.
